tagline: UBL-TR 1.2 e-Arşiv and e-Fatura invoices and return invoices from your Magento invoices, with VKN / TCKN and tax office at checkout, checked locally and sent through the GİB private integrator Nilvera.
key_features: UBL-TR 1.2 e-Fatura and e-Arşiv from Magento invoices
Return invoices (IADE) or the buyer's return invoice recorded
Internet sale details: web address, payment, carrier, dates
VKN or TCKN with checksum and tax office at checkout
GİB e-Fatura list check through Nilvera
ETTN, GİB number from Nilvera and KDV breakdown
Checked against the UBL 2.1 schema before sending
Customer download in My Account on Luma and Hyvä

benefits.title: The right document for each buyer
benefits.text: Buyers registered in GİB's e-Fatura list get an e-Fatura, everyone else an e-Arşiv invoice. The module checks the list through Nilvera before sending.

benefits.title: Tax IDs collected at checkout
benefits.text: Turkish customers enter their VKN (companies, 10 digits) or T.C. identity number (persons, 11 digits), checked with the official checksum; companies add their tax office.

benefits.title: Sent and tracked by cron
benefits.text: Cron generates and validates each document, uploads it to Nilvera, polls the status and records every step in the audit trail.

showcase.label: Checkout
showcase.title: VKN / TCKN and tax office
showcase.text: For a Turkish billing address the checkout asks for the tax number (VKN) or T.C. identity number (TCKN), checked on the server with the checksum. Business buyers also enter their tax office.

showcase.label: Invoices
showcase.title: UBL-TR 1.2 from every invoice
showcase.text: Each Magento invoice becomes a UBL-TR document with ETTN, GİB invoice number assigned by Nilvera in your series, seller and buyer tax IDs and tax offices, lines and the KDV breakdown.

showcase.label: Returns
showcase.title: Returns the GİB way
showcase.text: By default the e-Fatura buyer issues the return invoice and consumer returns use the invoice's return section; you record that document. Or the module sends a return invoice (IADE) that refers to the original's GİB number.

showcase.label: Sending
showcase.title: Through Nilvera, without duplicates
showcase.text: Documents are uploaded to Nilvera's e-Fatura or e-Arşiv service with your API key. A repeated upload with the same ETTN is recognised, so an invoice is never sent twice.

showcase.label: Customer account
showcase.title: UBL-TR download in My Account
showcase.text: Logged-in customers download the XML of their invoices and return invoices under Electronic Invoices, on Luma and Hyvä.
